fullDescription: Full-bleed dark CTA band: a frosted-glass panel floating over a luminous aurora glow that rises from the bottom, with a gradient-clipped accent headline, dual buttons and a trust row. Dark ink, aqua-to-magenta accent, Space Grotesk + Inter, sticky frosted nav + minimal footer.
prompt:
## Resumo A full-bleed dark CTA band anchored by a frosted-glass panel that floats over a luminous aurora glow rising from the bottom edge. A slim context strip (eyebrow pill, headline, subhead, and a 4-up row of drawn prompt thumbnails) sets product context above the band; a sticky frosted nav sits above and a minimal footer below. Dark ink background, aqua-to-magenta gradient accent, Space Grotesk display + Inter body. ## Estilo Visual Premium dark-mode SaaS landing aesthetic. Background ink near-black #0b0f14 (section uses radial-gradient(120% 90% at 50% 0%, #11171f 0%, #0b0f14 55%, #080b0f 100%)), body text off-white #e8eef2 with white/40 to white/65 for secondary copy. Dual-accent gradient ramp: aqua #2dd4bf -> cyan #67e8f9 -> magenta #e879f9, used as button fills, gradient-clipped accent text (linear-gradient(100deg, #2dd4bf 0%, #67e8f9 38%, #e879f9 100%)), and glow color. Typefaces: 'Space Grotesk' (weights 500/600/700) for display headings via .font-display, 'Inter' (weights 400/500/600/700) for body, antialiased, optimizeLegibility, tight tracking on headings. Signature hardware: a frosted .glass panel (background linear-gradient(155deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.07), rgba(255,255,255,0.025)); backdrop-filter blur(22px) saturate(140%); 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.10) border; box-shadow 0 40px 90px -30px rgba(0,0,0,0.7) + inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.12)); a blurred radial .aurora glow rising from the bottom (aqua rgba(45,212,191,0.85) + magenta rgba(232,121,249,0.60) + cyan rgba(103,232,249,0.45), blur(30px)) with a softer .aurora-bloom (blur(50px)) and a sharp .horizon line (aqua->white->magenta gradient, 2px, box-shadow 0 0 50px 10px rgba(45,212,191,0.55)); subtle SVG fractal-noise film grain at opacity .035 mix-blend overlay; a radial dot-grid (rgba(255,255,255,0.10) 1px on a 26px pitch). Buttons: .btn-primary aqua->magenta gradient (linear-gradient(110deg, #2dd4bf, #34e3cf 45%, #e879f9 130%)) with dark #06120f text + aqua glow shadow, lifts translateY(-1px) on hover; .btn-ghost white/04 fill + white/16 border, hover to aqua border. Frosted sticky nav: rgba(11,15,20,0.55) + backdrop-blur(14px) saturate(140%). Iconify Phosphor icons (ph:*). ## Layout e Estrutura ### Sticky frosted nav Sticky top header (top-0, z-50), .nav-blur background (rgba(11,15,20,0.55) + backdrop-blur(14px) saturate(140%)) with a 1px white/06 bottom border. Inner nav mx-auto max-w-6xl px-6 h-16, flex items-center justify-between. Left: logo = a w-8 h-8 rounded-lg tile with an aqua->magenta gradient fill (linear-gradient(135deg,#2dd4bf,#e879f9)) + a glow shadow, holding a dark #06120f ph:sparkle-fill icon, beside a 'Halo' wordmark in .font-display 17px font-700 tracking-tight. Center (hidden under md): nav links Library / Canvas / Skills / Pricing at 14px white/65 font-medium, hover to white. Right: a 'Sign in' text link (hidden under sm, white/70) + a .btn-primary 'Start free' pill (rounded-full px-4 py-2, 13.5px font-600) with a trailing ph:arrow-right-bold icon. ### Context strip (above the band) A relative .grain section with a bottom white/5 border. Inner mx-auto max-w-6xl px-6 pt-24 pb-16, centered. Top: a .ring-chip eyebrow pill (rounded-full px-3.5 py-1.5, bg rgba(45,212,191,0.08), 1px rgba(45,212,191,0.28) border, 12.5px aqua text) = a ph:lightning-fill icon + '2,400+ production-grade prompts'. Then an h2 in .font-display mt-6 at 3xl (md:4xl) font-700 tracking-tight white/95 max-w-2xl leading-[1.12]: 'From a one-line idea to a shippable interface.'. Then a 15-16px white/55 subhead (max-w-xl): 'Browse the library, drop a prompt on the infinite canvas, and let the design agent render real components you can ship today.'. Then a mt-10 grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4 (max-w-4xl) of four .thumb cards (rounded-2xl p-4, 1px white/07 border, faint white gradient fill), each: a h-20 rounded-lg .dot-grid tile tinted with a faint accent bg holding a duotone Phosphor icon (ph:credit-card-duotone aqua, ph:squares-four-duotone magenta, ph:fingerprint-duotone cyan, ph:device-mobile-duotone aqua) + a 13px font-600 white/85 title + a 12px white/45 caption ('Pricing table / 3-tier, dark', 'Dashboard shell / sidebar + stats', 'Auth flow / sign-in + OTP', 'Mobile onboarding / 4 screens'). ### CTA band shell + aurora glow A relative overflow-hidden .grain section (id='cta') with a radial-gradient background (120% 90% at 50% 0%, #11171f 0%, #0b0f14 55%, #080b0f 100%). Three pointer-events-none glow layers rise from the bottom: an .aurora-bloom (soft radial aqua bloom, blur(50px), z-0), an .aurora (the main glow - radial aqua rgba(45,212,191,0.85) at 42% + magenta rgba(232,121,249,0.60) at 64% + cyan rgba(103,232,249,0.45), 150% wide x 64% tall, blur(30px), z-0), and a sharp .horizon line (56% wide, 2px, aqua->cyan->white->magenta gradient with a 0 0 50px 10px aqua box-shadow, z-1) sitting just above the glow. Content wrapper relative z-10 mx-auto max-w-6xl px-6 pt-28 pb-44 (md:pt-32 md:pb-56). ### Frosted glass CTA panel Centered .glass panel (frosted: linear-gradient(155deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.07), rgba(255,255,255,0.025)); backdrop-blur(22px) saturate(140%); 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.10) border; 0 40px 90px -30px rgba(0,0,0,0.7) drop + inset top highlight), relative mx-auto max-w-3xl rounded-[28px] px-8 py-14 (md:px-16 md:py-16), text-center, overflow-hidden, with a faint inner aurora bloom behind it (absolute -bottom-24, radial aqua rgba(45,212,191,0.30), blur(30px)). Inside, stacked: an eyebrow pill (rounded-full px-3 py-1, bg white/05, 1px white/10 border, 12px white/70) = a 1.5px aqua dot with an aqua glow + 'No credit card required'; an h1 in .font-display mt-6 at 4xl (md:56px) font-700 leading-[1.05] tracking-tight where 'Design tools' is gradient-clipped .accent-text and 'that developers actually ship' is white (a sm:block
after 'that'); a mt-5 max-w-md 15-16.5px white/60 subhead 'Prompt the canvas, remix the library, hand off clean code. Go from idea to a shippable UI in a single afternoon, no design debt.'; a mt-9 flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-3.5 button row = a .btn-primary 'Start designing free' pill (rounded-full px-7 py-3.5, 15px font-600, full-width on mobile) + a ph:arrow-right-bold, beside a .btn-ghost 'Browse the library' pill led by a ph:book-open-duotone; a mt-8 flex justify-center gap-5 inline trust row at 12.5px white/40 of three ph:check-circle-fill items ('Infinite canvas' aqua, 'Code export' magenta, 'Agent skill' aqua, the last hidden under sm). ### Footer A relative footer with a top white/6 border. Inner mx-auto max-w-6xl px-6 py-10, flex flex-col md:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-4, 13px white/40. Left: a small w-6 h-6 rounded-md aqua->magenta gradient logo tile with a dark ph:sparkle-fill + a 'Halo' wordmark (.font-display font-600 white/70) + a 'copyright 2026' note. Right: text links Library / Docs / Changelog / X / Twitter at white/40, hover to white/80. ## Componentes Especiais de UI ### Componente Frosted-glass CTA panel (translucent white fill + backdrop-blur + inset top highlight + deep drop shadow) floating over the aurora ### Componente Aurora glow rising from the bottom edge (layered blurred radial aqua/magenta/cyan gradients) + a soft secondary bloom ### Componente A single sharp glowing horizon line (aqua->white->magenta) with a wide aqua box-shadow, sitting above the glow ### Componente Gradient-clipped accent text (aqua->cyan->magenta) on one key phrase of the headline ### Componente Dual CTA buttons: aqua->magenta gradient primary + white/04 ghost, both rounded-full with Phosphor icons ### Componente Eyebrow status pill with a glowing aqua dot ('No credit card required') ### Componente Inline trust row with aqua/magenta check-circle icons ### Componente Drawn prompt-thumbnail grid (4-up) with duotone icons on a dot-grid tile, as product context above the band ### Componente Frosted/blurred sticky nav scrim (.nav-blur) ### Componente Subtle SVG fractal-noise film grain + a faint radial dot-grid texture ## Notas Especiais The reusable value is the FROSTED-GLASS-ON-AURORA CTA BAND: a centered glass panel floating over a luminous aurora glow that rises from the bottom of a full-bleed dark section, with a single sharp glowing horizon line and one gradient-clipped accent phrase. Keep the dual aqua(#2dd4bf)->magenta(#e879f9) accent (via cyan #67e8f9) on near-black ink (#0b0f14) off-white (#e8eef2) text. The glow/bloom/horizon are pointer-events-none absolute layers clipped by the section's overflow-hidden; the glass needs real backdrop-blur to read. Display headings use Space Grotesk, body uses Inter. Icons via Iconify Phosphor (ph:*). Responsive: nav center links hide below md and the Sign in link below sm; the headline drops from 56px to 4xl with the
hidden under sm; the CTA button row stacks full-width below sm; the third trust item and the footer right links reflow; no horizontal overflow at 390px.
